info.title: Client Data Encryption Key Get Open Banking
info.description: REST Utility framework to retrieve cryptographic instructions such as public Customer Management key (CMK) details, encryption method and algorithm etc based on a resource uri and key alias. The key can be used to encryt, but not decrypt the data.

x-fapi-financial-id.name: x-fapi-financial-id
x-fapi-financial-id.description: The unique id of the financial institution to which the request is issued. BMO is 001

x-fapi-customer-last-logged-time.name: x-fapi-customer-last-logged-time
x-fapi-customer-last-logged-time.description: The time when the Payment Services User last logged in with the Third Party Provider

x-fapi-customer-ip-address.name: x-fapi-customer-ip-address
x-fapi-customer-ip-address.description: The Payment Services User’s IP address if the Payment Services User is currently logged in with the Third Party Provider.

x-fapi-customer-user-agent.name: x-fapi-customer-user-agent
x-fapi-customer-user-agent.description: Indicates the user-agent that the Payment Services User is using https://www.computerhope.com/jargon/u/useragen.htm

x-fapi-interaction-id.name: x-fapi-interaction-id
x-fapi-interaction-id.description: An RFC 4122 UID used  to consolidate multiple requests for ex. in a particular session of the customer/employee. Multiple requests  with unique  x-request-id’s might have common  x-fapi-interaction-id.If there is no need to link multiple API calls then the x-fapi-interaction-id values is the same as x-request-id.

x-client-id.name: x-client-id
x-client-id.description: Client Id generated during Third Party Provider application registration

Authorization.name: Authorization
Authorization.description: An Authorization Token as per https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6750

x-request-id.name: x-request-id
x-request-id.description: Correlates HTTP requests between a client and server. Uniquely identifies each API call.

x-api-key.name: x-api-key
x-api-key.description: The unique id used to identify caller of the API. (For legacy, AppCatId value could be used)

x-app-cat-id.name: x-app-cat-id
x-app-cat-id.description: BMO Application Catalogue ID of the consumer of the API. To be provided if API call is initiated by a BMO Application. BMO Application Catalogue https://appcat.bmogc.net/servlet/ApmServer
